dedupeText: retro compilation album layout 1960s pop duotone blue red header slab serif collage album reissue primary color palette red header bar containing yellow display text blue duotone background image with high contrast right aligned vertical stack of inset square graphics circular promotional badge in the bottom center right combine a color duotone background image with a contrast color header bar containing display font text and number inset square graphics for a retro anthology look

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled layout featuring a large duotone blue portrait background overlaid with smaller full-color album art and a bold red header bar.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition utilizing a primary color scheme (red, blue, yellow) where a monochromatic blue-tinted group portrait serves as the canvas for inset rectangular album covers and a dominant top-aligned red title banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Red header bar containing yellow display text
Blue duotone background image with high contrast
Right-aligned vertical stack of inset square graphics
Circular promotional badge in the bottom center-right
coreInvariants: Primary red, blue, and yellow color palette
Duotone treatment on the main background subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large group portrait occupying the left two-thirds and full height of the blue area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Top red banner with large yellow text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top red banner, moves down the left side through the blue portrait, then shifts to the right-side inset squares and bottom badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight composition with minimal negative space, filled by the blue texture of the background image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Royal blue duotone for the background imagery.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for the header bar and circular badge.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors against a mid-value blue duotone background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Blocky, thick slabs for the main title
Uniform stroke width for the subtitle sans-serif
Tight letter spacing in the header
characterSpecificRedesigns: Drop shadows on the yellow slab serif to create depth against red
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with condensed sans-serif for information density.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style
Matches the condensed sans-serif subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a blue duotone group portrait of 5-6 people in 1960s attire. Add a solid red bar at the top and two white-bordered square placeholders on the right side. Place a red circular badge at the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large yellow slab-serif text to the red bar with a slight drop shadow. Add white condensed sans-serif text below it. Place arched white text inside the red circular badge.

verificationChecks: Is the background image a consistent blue duotone?
Is the header text yellow on a red background?
Are the inset graphics clearly bordered in white?
Is the main title a heavy slab-serif font?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red header is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the yellow text has a legible drop shadow.
Check that the duotone effect doesn't lose facial details.
Confirm the circular badge text follows the curve correctly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] duotone background image with a [Contrast Color] header bar containing [Display Font] text and [Number] inset square graphics for a retro anthology look.
